issue_context.title: Support for libSQL/Turso
issue_context.body:
### Feature Description

Possibility to use libSQL or Turso as a database

### The Solution

Build support for libSQL extending the functionality of sqlite

### Considered Alternatives

None other than using another database type

### Additional Context

_No response_

```typescript

  type: "sqlite",
  driver: require("@libsql/sqlite3"),
  flags: 0x00000040, // this is required to make it work in TypeORM
  database:
    "libsql://example.turso.io?authToken=...",
  // ....
});
```

Thank you for the request.

As we bring TypeORM back into active development, we have decided not to accept any new driver requests at this time. This allows us to focus on improving and supporting the core platform.

This issue will be closed for now, but will be labeled with "new driver" so it is easily findable in the future.
